components.name: Enter Floor Button
components.description: The dominant route into the next online adventure.
components.css: .ds-enter-floor{width:100%;min-height:118px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;gap:12px;border:4px solid var(--game-outline,#4d332d);border-radius:var(--radius-control,14px);padding:0 20px;background:var(--game-gold,#ffc943);color:var(--p-ink,#3b3434);font-family:ui-rounded,'Arial Rounded MT Bold','Noto Sans Thai',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:inset 0 3px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 72%),0 7px 14px rgb(84 52 43 / 22%);transition:transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-enter-floor>span:last-child{display:grid;text-align:left}.ds-enter-floor strong{font-size:clamp(22px,2.6vw,34px)}.ds-enter-floor small{font-weight:700}.ds-enter-floor:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}.ds-enter-floor:active{transform:translateY(2px);box-shadow:inset 0 2px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 72%),0 3px 7px rgb(84 52 43 / 22%)}.ds-enter-floor:focus-visible{outline:4px solid var(--p-focus,#315f9f);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Practice Button
components.description: A tactile secondary action for the local practice route.
components.css: .ds-practice{width:100%;min-height:62px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:var(--radius-control,14px);padding:0 20px;background:var(--game-mint,#83d8bc);color:var(--p-ink,#3b3434);font-family:ui-rounded,'Arial Rounded MT Bold','Noto Sans Thai',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:inset 0 3px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 72%),0 7px 14px rgb(84 52 43 / 22%);transition:transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-practice>span:last-child{display:grid;text-align:left}.ds-practice small{font-weight:700}.ds-practice:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}.ds-practice:active{transform:translateY(2px);box-shadow:inset 0 2px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 72%),0 3px 7px rgb(84 52 43 / 22%)}.ds-practice:focus-visible{outline:4px solid var(--p-focus,#315f9f);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Hero Name Field
components.description: The friendly, high-contrast identity field used before entering the tower.
components.css: .ds-hero-field{display:grid;gap:9px;color:var(--p-ink,#3b3434);font-family:ui-rounded,'Arial Rounded MT Bold','Noto Sans Thai',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:900}.ds-hero-field input{width:100%;min-height:50px;border:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--p-chocolate,#684338) 42%,transparent);border-radius:var(--radius-control,14px);padding:0 13px;background:var(--p-white,#fffdf7);color:var(--p-ink,#3b3434);font:inherit}.ds-hero-field small{color:var(--p-muted,#75635c);font-size:12px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.45}.ds-hero-field input:hover{border-color:var(--p-chocolate,#684338)}.ds-hero-field input:focus{border-color:var(--p-chocolate,#684338);outline:4px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--p-focus,#315f9f) 28%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}.ds-hero-field input:focus-visible{border-color:var(--p-chocolate,#684338);outline:4px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--p-focus,#315f9f) 28%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Adventure Navigation
components.description: Five icon-and-label destinations in a tactile dock with an elevated active state.
components.css: .ds-adventure-nav{height:68px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));align-items:end;padding:4px;border:3px solid var(--game-outline,#4d332d);border-radius:20px;background:var(--plastic-light,#fffef9);box-shadow:inset 0 3px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 72%),0 10px 24px rgb(84 52 43 / 22%)}.ds-nav-tab{min-width:0;min-height:58px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;border:2px solid transparent;border-radius:16px;background:transparent;color:var(--board-ink-muted,#75635c);font-family:ui-rounded,'Arial Rounded MT Bold','Noto Sans Thai',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-nav-tab span{font-size:10px}.ds-nav-tab:hover{background:rgb(255 201 67 / 28%);transform:translateY(-2px)}.ds-nav-tab.ds-active{border-color:var(--game-outline,#4d332d);background:var(--game-gold,#ffc943);color:var(--p-ink,#3b3434);transform:translateY(-7px);box-shadow:inset 0 3px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 72%),0 6px 12px rgb(84 52 43 / 22%)}.ds-nav-tab:focus-visible{outline:4px solid var(--p-focus,#315f9f);outline-offset:2px}.ds-nav-tab:active{transform:translateY(1px)}

components.css: .ds-mission-card{display:grid;gap:12px;padding:18px;border:4px solid var(--game-outline,#4d332d);border-radius:20px;background:var(--game-paper,#fff9e9);color:var(--p-ink,#3b3434);font-family:ui-rounded,'Arial Rounded MT Bold','Noto Sans Thai',system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:inset 0 3px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 65%),0 9px 0 rgb(77 51 45 / 22%),0 18px 36px rgb(77 51 45 / 18%)}.ds-mission-sign{padding:12px;border:3px solid var(--game-outline,#4d332d);border-radius:13px;background:var(--game-purple,#9a75d8);color:#fff;text-align:center;transform:rotate(1deg);box-shadow:inset 0 3px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 65%),0 7px 16px rgb(77 51 45 / 22%)}.ds-mission-sign span{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-mission-sign strong{display:block;font-size:48px;line-height:.95}.ds-mission-sign p{margin:6px 0 0;font-weight:800}.ds-mission-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:7px}.ds-mission-stats>span{display:grid;min-width:0;padding:10px 7px;border:2px solid var(--game-outline,#4d332d);border-radius:11px;background:#f2e3c7;text-align:center}.ds-mission-stats small{color:var(--p-muted,#75635c);font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-mission-stats b{overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-size:12px}

components.name: Progress Shortcut
components.description: A compact tactile shortcut for collection, summons, or upgrades.
components.css: .ds-progress{min-height:76px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;border:3px solid var(--game-outline,#4d332d);border-radius:var(--radius-control,14px);padding:12px;background:var(--game-paper,#fff9e9);color:var(--p-ink,#3b3434);font-family:ui-rounded,'Arial Rounded MT Bold','Noto Sans Thai',system-ui,sans-serif;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:inset 0 3px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 65%),0 8px 18px rgb(77 51 45 / 16%);transition:transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-progress>span:last-child{display:grid}.ds-progress strong{font-weight:900}.ds-progress small{color:var(--p-muted,#75635c)}.ds-progress-icon{font-size:26px;color:var(--game-gold,#ffc943)}.ds-progress:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}.ds-progress:focus-visible{outline:4px solid var(--p-focus,#315f9f);outline-offset:3px}.ds-progress:active{transform:translateY(1px)}

components.name: Empty Party Slot
components.description: An arched dashed silhouette that makes missing party members actionable.
components.css: .ds-empty-slot{width:150px;min-height:190px;display:grid;place-content:center;justify-items:center;gap:8px;border:3px dashed var(--game-paper,#fff9e9);border-radius:46% 46% 18px 18px;background:rgb(44 41 52 / 70%);color:var(--game-paper,#fff9e9);font-family:ui-rounded,'Arial Rounded MT Bold','Noto Sans Thai',system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-empty-slot>span{width:52px;height:52px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:3px solid currentColor;border-radius:50%;font-size:28px}.ds-empty-slot strong{font-weight:900}.ds-empty-slot:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);background:rgb(77 51 45 / 88%)}.ds-empty-slot:focus-visible{outline:4px solid var(--p-focus,#315f9f);outline-offset:3px}.ds-empty-slot:active{transform:translateY(1px)}

narrative.overview:
Odd Tower is a character-first adventure lobby, not a centered dashboard grid. The interface should feel like a cheerful game board assembled from cream paper, carved tower stone, painted ribbons, toy-like plastic controls, and thick cocoa ink. Characters occupy the visual stage; resources and progress form a compact supporting HUD; the next adventure is the unmistakable action.

The world is cute, strange, energetic, and slightly handmade. Small rotations, inset highlights, irregular silhouettes, illustrated fallbacks, and soft offset depth make controls feel physical without sacrificing legibility. Saturated rarity colors punctuate a warm neutral base, while every state remains data-honest, keyboard-visible, touch-friendly, localization-resilient, and useful at narrow or short viewports.
keyCharacteristics: Character artwork and party formation dominate the first view.
Cream paper and tower stone are bounded by thick cocoa outlines.
Gold, coral, mint, sky, and purple communicate action and game roles.
Inset highlights and downward shadows make controls feel pressable.
Small rotations and ribbon silhouettes supply handmade personality.
Responsive navigation moves from a bottom dock to a left rail without changing hierarchy.

rules.name: The Cocoa Line Rule
rules.body: Major interactive or narrative objects use a dark cocoa boundary; do not replace that structure with faint gray hairlines.

rules.name: The Gold Means Go Rule
rules.body: Adventure Gold belongs to the primary route and active home state. Keep it rare enough that “Enter Floor” remains unmistakable.

rules.name: The Color-Plus-Shape Rule
rules.body: Never communicate active, locked, failed, or rare states by hue alone; pair color with labels, borders, icons, or position.

rules.name: The Rounded Voice Rule
rules.body: All persistent-shell text uses the rounded stack, including Thai fallback; do not introduce a generic geometric sans inside the game lobby.

rules.name: The Sign, Not Spreadsheet Rule
rules.body: Compact labels should read like painted plaques—short, bold, and contextual—not like dense dashboard column headers.

rules.name: The Stacked Toy Rule
rules.body: Large objects combine outline, inset shine, and downward depth; never use a generic floating gray shadow as the only separator.

rules.name: The Pressed State Rule
rules.body: On activation, controls move down and their shadow shortens, preserving the physical model.

rules.name: The Silhouette Mix Rule
rules.body: Pair grounded rounded panels with at least one relevant sign, ribbon, arch, sticker, or illustrated shape in focal game compositions.

dos: Do keep characters and party formation larger than resource and progress summaries.
Do preserve the cocoa outline, inset shine, and soft offset-depth combination on focal game objects.
Do reserve Adventure Gold for the clearest next action and the active home route.
Do use stable hero-art boxes with themed illustrated fallback states.
Do maintain safe-area padding, visible keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, and at least 44px touch targets.
Do let English, Thai, long names, and large values wrap, truncate, or reflow intentionally.
donts: Don't turn the lobby into a centered analytics dashboard or a uniform card grid.
Don't flatten the world into borderless pastel rectangles or faint gray dividers.
Don't let secondary progress, shop-like actions, or resources compete with Enter Floor.
Don't use hue as the only signal for active, error, rarity, or lock state.
Don't expose broken-image chrome, clipped fixed-width labels, hidden focus, or motion that ignores reduced-motion preferences.
Don't copy protected characters, artwork, branding, or layouts from reference games.
